patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.quote: My chest is tight and I can't... catch... a full breath. My inhaler isn't cutting it. I can only get a few words out at a time.
presentation.triageNote: 24-year-old female with asthma whose inhaler is no longer relieving her breathing difficulty. She has widespread wheeze, uses accessory muscles, and can speak only three words at a time; oxygen saturation is 93%.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player's assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 2 is appropriate because inability to speak more than a few words with accessory-muscle use indicates severe respiratory distress requiring rapid treatment.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This patient with asthma has persistent dyspnea despite her inhaler, widespread wheeze, tachypnea, accessory-muscle use, and oxygen saturation 93%.
clinical.acuityReason: Limited speech and increased work of breathing are high-risk signs even before oxygen saturation becomes profoundly low.
expectedResources: Escalation of ventilatory support if fatigue develops
keyFindings: Speaks only three words at a time
redFlags: Severe work of breathing with limited speech
Risk of fatigue or silent chest
teachingPoints: A quieter chest in a tiring patient may indicate worsening airflow rather than improvement.
Treatment response must be reassessed frequently using speech, air movement, work of breathing, and oxygenation.

possibleDiagnoses: Pulmonary embolism or pneumothorax if the course is atypical
possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: Rapid inhaled therapy, steroids, oxygen, and repeated reassessment would determine whether discharge after sustained improvement or monitored admission is appropriate.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.pose: leaning forward, hands on knees (tripod), working to breathe
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a black 24-year-old woman, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: leaning forward in a tripod position, hands braced on her knees, working to breathe. Expression: anxious and breathless. Clearly visible: a hunched tripod posture and the effort of hard breathing. No text, no logos.
